listing.title: iPhone 13 Pro iCloud Lock Scrap Board — Complete ICs (Virgin Board)
listing.description: Fresh pull mula sa basag likod at LCD na iPhone 13 Pro. Clean history, virgin board walang bakas ng blower o rework. Complete lahat ng ICs (CPU, PMIC, Baseband, NAND 256GB). Good for board swap o IC transfer.
listing.diagnostics: Tested on DC power supply: normal boot current drawing up to 0.75A bago mag lock sa setup screen. Walang short sa VDD_MAIN at VBAT. Lahat ng connectors intact.

listing.title: Bawas Kalat 15pcs Dead Phone Lot — Pang Reball / Practice Board
listing.description: Bawas kalat sa shop! 15 pirasong sirang cellphone at donor boards (mostly Redmi Note 8, Note 9, 9A). Perfect na perfect sa mga baguhang technician na nagpa-practice mag-reball sa microscope at mag-stencil.
listing.diagnostics: Visual condition: halo-halo, karamihan basag LCD at grounded boards. Ilan may missing camera o connector. Sold as-is para sa scrap at micro-soldering training.

listing.title: Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra Exynos Motherboard — Shorted Vbat Line
listing.description: S22 Ultra mainboard galing water-damaged unit. Complete lahat ng components, intact thermal graphite pads at camera mount. Maganda para sa marunong mag-short killer o thermal camera diagnostics.
listing.diagnostics: Multimeter diode mode reading: 0.002V on VBAT positive line (direct short to ground). Power management IC section shows minor corrosion but CPU and NAND are pristine.

listing.title: OPPO A94 Donor Board — Grade A Intact (Water Damaged / Good Silicon)
listing.description: Intact OPPO A94 logic board with 128GB internal storage and 8GB LPDDR4x RAM. Water sensor turned red, but motherboard has complete chips and good connectors.
listing.diagnostics: Ultrasonic bath cleaned. Solder pads bright. Sourcing candidate for camera FPC, battery connector, and MediaTek power management IC.

listing.title: Redmi Note 11 128GB ROM / 6GB RAM Scrap Board (Grounded Board)
listing.description: Original Xiaomi donor board galing sa basag na phone. Complete shielding, intact ang charging flex connector at FPC slots. Good donor para sa PMIC, audio codec, at UFS flash storage chip.
listing.diagnostics: Connects to DC power supply with 0.18A auto-draw on 4.2V line. Hindi umiinit ang CPU, malamang secondary cap o charging IC ang grounded. Virgin pads.

listing.title: Vivo Y20 Dead Unit for Parts — Basag LCD, Good Motherboard Sub-Assembly
listing.description: Sirang silpon unit pull. Basag ang salamin at display pero nagba-vibrate pa pag sinaksak sa charger at naririnig ang startup tone. Board is fully functional at unworked.

listing.title: iPhone 11 Pro Max Shattered OLED Display Assembly (For Glass Refurbishing)

listing.title: Samsung Galaxy A52 Motherboard Lot (5pcs) — Unchecked Greenhills Batch

listing.title: Bulk E-Waste Vintage Keypad Phones (50pcs) — Gold Recovery & PCB Scrap
listing.description: 50 pirasong lumang de-keypad na cellphone (Nokia, Samsung Metro, Cherry Mobile, MyPhone). Mataas ang gold plating content sa keyboard contacts at connector bus. Pure scrap grade C.
listing.diagnostics: Strictly for e-waste recycling and precious metal hydrometallurgical extraction. Complete with boards, chassis, and obsolete keypad chips.

listing.title: iPhone 12 Mini Logic Board — Grade A Complete (No History of Repair)
listing.description: Compact iPhone 12 Mini motherboard. Walang galaw ang sandwich solder joints, intact ang interposer layers. Clean ICs all around (CPU, PMIC, Baseband, NAND flash 128GB).
listing.diagnostics: Sandwich layers factory-sealed. Diode mode values on battery terminal match OEM reference schematics (0.420V on VBAT).

listing.title: Poco X3 Pro Dead CPU Board — Reball or Parts Harvest (UFS 128GB)
listing.description: Classic Poco X3 Pro sudden death syndrome. Hindi pa nabubloweran ng ibang tech, virgin RAM/CPU sandwich. Magandang project para sa reballing technician o source ng UFS storage.
listing.diagnostics: Stuck on 0.20A steady draw when connected to DC power supply (EDL mode detectable via USB Test Point 9008). Reballing CPU & RAM should restore device.

listing.title: Xiaomi 11T Pro 256GB / 8GB RAM Logic Board with Snapdragon 888
listing.description: High-tier Xiaomi donor board na may flagship Snapdragon 888 processor at 256GB high-speed UFS 3.1 storage. Kasama dual charge pump ICs para sa 120W charging system.
listing.diagnostics: Pulled from crushed chassis unit. Motherboard is flat and undamaged, connectors intact, no burn marks on charging controller.

listing.title: Samsung S20 FE 5G Display Assembly — Glass Cracked, Touch & OLED 100% OK
listing.description: Original Samsung Service Pack display pull. May hairline crack sa lower right corner ng salamin pero walang sira ang OLED image at walang dead pixels. Responsive 120Hz touch.

listing.title: Vivo V23 5G Laser-Etched PMIC & Fast Charging IC Pair (Tested Good)

listing.title: Samsung Galaxy Note 20 Ultra 5G Motherboard 256GB / 12GB RAM (No Power)
listing.description: Flagship Note 20 Ultra logic board. S-Pen digitizer connector, periscope camera socket, and triple-camera FPC all intact. Clean board, no technician repair history.
listing.diagnostics: Zero current draw on power button press. Suspected secondary buck converter issue or open zero-ohm resistor on power trigger line.

listing.description: Premium top-of-the-line iPhone 14 Pro Max donor board with 512GB high-capacity NAND flash memory. Complete dual-layer motherboard with untouched factory solder.

listing.title: Xiaomi Mi 10T 128GB Motherboard — Stuck on Fastboot (Good Hardware)

listing.title: iPhone 12 Pro Max Face ID Sensor & Front Earpiece Flex Assembly
